spanish: Y llamó nombre del lugar aquel Kivrot Hataavá, porque allí enterraron al pueblo los codiciantes.

findings.issue: The 3cp verb has no lexical subject; the definite masculine-plural hithpael participle may modify the singular object העם or stand as the plural subject. Spanish makes los codiciantes the buriers and al pueblo a separate patient.

notes: Name tokens are proper nouns; Kivrot Hataavá is not a locked-name mismatch.
